{{Top|leg}}
'''Beacon pods''' were used for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] navigation purposes while in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. [[Pellezara station]], a stopover point for [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]], featured beacon pods.
